resolved_findings: Split drafts now participate in synchronous revision retirement and explicit replacement disclosure.
Retired read busy state is owner-scoped; obsolete promises cannot block or clear fresh work.
Refresh and original save/split/merge/download starts synchronously retire old import callbacks.
checks: Exact original {version,digest} asset_snapshot plus record/version/asset/timebase/file bytes SHA/length/format response binding.
Bounded UTF8 file read preserves BOM/CRLF bytes; no transformation or time rounding in frontend.
Known Cue field copy, bounded unique IDs and text, safe integer times, no segment/overlap attribution.
Explicit replacement fills only local unsaved cues; existing saveCues retains CAS ownership.
Late callbacks and async reads check current owner/selection/draft/admission and layout unmount lifetime.
Original protected tests untouched; new regression file only.
limitations: UNKNOWN save assertion proves no automatic retry; original owner has no new durable unknown-result lock.
No browser/file-picker, PostgreSQL, media processing, or model-quality acceptance.
